text: This is Axys. A shop owner sends a photo and a voice note on WhatsApp, and gets a website, a reel and a caption, with every price checked by code.
Models can state the wrong thing with confidence. First time here? Play with this page to see why, then try our real checks.
Muse Voice transcribes the note. The assistant pulls out the facts and asks the owner to confirm them. Then the draft continues in the Studio.
In the Studio the facts arrive pre filled. Muse Spark identifies the product, SAM cuts it out, and Muse Image builds the backdrops.
Muse Wonder plans the film, and writes the narration you are about to hear.
Now change the price just by saying it. Code checks every number against your words, Red Pen marks every stale surface, and one press fixes them all.
The code can publish through Instagram's API. Here is how the reel looks there.
The code fetches real Instagram insights; these are sample numbers. The loop quotes only observed numbers and proposes one change.
Agents propose. Code decides. That is Axys.
